title: Malicious code in sirens-lamentt (npm)
description: The npm package sirens-lamentt version 99.0.2 contains malicious code that executes a postinstall script. This script sends an HTTPS GET request to a hardcoded webhook.site URL, transmitting the installer's IP address and install event data to a third-party collector. The behavior is consistent with a dependency confusion attack probe targeting internal package names.
